text.en:
The National Highway-Lamao Port Provincial Road in the Municipality of Liloy, Province of
Zamboanga del Norte, connecting a three and a half kilometer (3.5) road from the Port of Lamao to the
national highway, is hereby converted into a national road.

The amount necessary for the improvement and maintenance of said road shall continue to be
funded out of the lump sum appropriation authorized under Batas Pambansa Blg. 640 for the repair and
maintenance funds for said road shall have been provided for in the succeeding appropriations acts.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: April 13, 1984
